contradicting_evidence.note: Called in the SAME session on the SAME two charts, kala_now_get successfully returned a fully-populated dasha_sandhi field with real boundary bands (level_n=1 Mahadasha and level_n=2 Antardasha period_start/period_end bands with real dates), sourced per its own provenance_envelope.assets from 'get_dashas (chart_dashas, level_n=4)'. This proves the underlying L1 dasha data is fully reachable — the failure is specific to kala_dasha_sandhi_get's own dispatch path.

code_investigation.swallowed_error: callRegistry throws Error on any non-2xx HTTP response or payload.ok===false (dasha_sandhi.ts:85). fetchDashaRows (dasha_sandhi.ts:173,187-189) wraps this in try{...}catch{return {rows:[], reachable:false}}, discarding the real error. computeDashaSandhiCalendar (dasha_sandhi.ts:277-291) converts reachable:false into the generic 'could not be dispatched this call' message, never surfacing the actual HTTP status/error text.
code_investigation.root_cause: A dropped principal at tool-registration time. platform-mcp/src/tools/registry_bridge.ts:2112 receives the real, per-connection Principal (resolved from the caller's API key via validateMcpKeyFromHeader in server.ts:175/239) and passes it into registerAllKalaViews(server, principal) (registry_bridge.ts:4654). platform-mcp/src/tools/kala_views/register_all.ts:55-64 forwards that same real principal into every sibling kala_* tool registration (registerKalaNowGetTool(server, principal), etc.) EXCEPT registerDashaSandhiCalendar(server) (register_all.ts:64), which is called with NO principal argument. Inside dasha_sandhi.ts:358-362 the handler compensates by fabricating a hardcoded fake principal {user_uid:'system', key_id:'system', role:'super_admin'}. That fake identity does not correspond to a real MCP API key, so the platform's /api/retrieval/capability entitlement gate (route.ts:207-240, authorizeChartAccess) or key lookup fails/denies — producing the non-ok response that callRegistry throws on, silently converted to the 'could not be dispatched' honest-empty.
code_investigation.fix_direction: Change registerDashaSandhiCalendar(server: McpServer) to accept a Principal parameter, update the call site at register_all.ts:64 to pass the real principal, and use it instead of the hardcoded 'system' principal in dasha_sandhi.ts:361.
